''See also: [[Emperor's crown (The Elder Empire: Sea) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Emperor's crown is a significant golden circlet that served as the greatest treasure of the Emperor during his nearly two-millennium reign. While historical depictions show him wearing a bronze version, he eventually transitioned to the [[gold circlet]] to symbolize a new era for his civilization. [[The crown]] was primarily utilized during public appearances when the Emperor needed to project his status as the unified icon and founder of human civilization. As an invested object, it possessed more power than standard items, allowing the wearer to bolster their [[willpower]] and focus their anger. It also granted a level of command over others; while it could only offer suggestions to most, those who viewed themselves as loyal subjects of The Empire{{!}}the Empire were compelled to obey any command issued by the wearer. Although it was a powerful tool of Authority{{!}}authority, the Emperor only wore it to address the masses rather than for private administrative duties.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The Emperor's crown is a golden artifact utilized by Imperial Steward Calder Marten{{!}}Calder Marten. As an invested object of greater power than standard items, the crown contains bound [[Intent]]. Once it has been Awakened, the object can be used to control individuals against their will or to persuade the [[Consultants]].}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Emperor's crown is a lost Imperial relics{{!}}Imperial relic consisting of a [[gold circlet]] resting on a velvet lining. Originally crafted by the Guild of Magisters{{!}}Magister’s Guild with help from Regent{{!}}Regent Loreli, the artifact contains the memories of the Emperor and possesses the power to defend [[Calder]] or soothe allies. While its return would benefit The Empire{{!}}the Empire, it is a prize sought by [[Great Elders]] and potentially the Collector of Souls. [[The crown]] was eventually located inside a heavy [[safe]] held by a toad creature, though touching the object overwhelms a user with the sheer force of the Emperor's will.}}
